ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the left figure, the river channel is distributed nearly horizontally, and there is a small island formed by sediment accumulation in the river; the small island is located between the river bank labeled "Yi" above and the river bank labeled "Jia" below. Latitudes are marked on the right side of the figure, with 33°33′ above and 33°50′ below. The latitude values increase downward, indicating that this figure is located in the Southern Hemisphere. The estuary and arrows in the figure show that the river flows toward the estuary. Then reason: In the Southern Hemisphere, affected by the geostrophic deflection force, the direction of flowing water deflects to the left. After the mainstream deflects toward one side, the other side is relatively more likely to undergo sediment deposition. In the left figure, the small island will continue to accumulate and expand toward the lower Jia bank side, so it will eventually connect with bank Jia.

raw_record.question_text: The two figures below are respectively estuary maps of two large rivers. The small islands in the figures expand because of continuous sediment accumulation. According to <image1>, with which bank of the river will the small island in the left figure eventually connect?

method.method_draft: First describe the left image: the island lies between the upper bank labeled 乙 and the lower bank labeled 甲, and the latitude values indicate the diagram is in the Southern Hemisphere. Use the flow direction shown by the river mouth/arrows. Apply Coriolis deflection in the Southern Hemisphere: the current is deflected to its left, so the opposite side becomes the main depositional side. Therefore the island will keep accumulating sediment toward the lower bank labeled 甲 and eventually connect with 甲岸.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：左图中河道呈近水平分布，河中有一个由泥沙堆积形成的小岛；小岛位于上方标注为“乙”的河岸与下方标注为“甲”的河岸之间。图右侧标有纬度，上方为33°33′，下方为33°50′，纬度数值向下增大，说明该图位于南半球。图中河口和箭头显示河流向河口方向流动。
再推理：南半球受地转偏向力影响，流水运动方向向左偏。主流偏向一侧后，另一侧相对更容易发生泥沙淤积。左图中小岛会继续向下方的甲岸一侧淤积扩展，因此最终将与甲岸相连接。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In the Southern Hemisphere, moving water is deflected to the left of its direction of motion by the Coriolis force. method.method_draft: After visually locating the left island between 乙岸 and 甲岸, determine that the setting is Southern Hemisphere from the latitude ordering. Treat the two paths around the island as a stronger scouring branch and a weaker silting branch. With downstream flow toward the river mouth, Southern Hemisphere Coriolis makes the left-side branch the stronger scouring branch, so sediment preferentially fills the other branch beside the lower bank. Since that bank is labeled 甲, the island will eventually connect with 甲岸.
